description:
crate-jmap-calendars-server/README.md headline says 'all 20 method names'. The registered set in lib.rs is 19:
- Calendar (3): get/set/changes
- CalendarEvent (7): get/set/changes/query/queryChanges/copy/parse
- CalendarEventNotification (5): get/set/changes/query/queryChanges
- ParticipantIdentity (3): get/set/changes
- Principal/getAvailability (1)
Total: 3+7+5+3+1 = 19

The table contents in the README are correct; only the cardinality and the 'all 20' headline are wrong.

Fix: change to 'all 19 method names' and verify against draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26 §X.
title: P3: calendars-server README claims 'all 20 methods' (actual 19)
